text:
eva (Customer Support): FYI escalation from Acme GmbH. They received an EUR invoice that doesn't match their PO exactly (PO: EUR 12,345.67, invoice: EUR 12,345.66). They declined to approve and the card on file was auto-retried and failed with a currency error.
ben (Finance): Ack. Do we have invoice_id and payment_attempt ids?
eva (Customer Support): invoice_id: INV-2026-0897, payment_attempt: pay_8321. Customer says they need invoice in local entity format (Acme GmbH, DE) and exact PO match for their local AP system.
dinesh (Billing Eng): Can you paste the raw invoice JSON from payments logs? I want to check rounding/FX conversion fields.
eva (Customer Support): Paste from ticket:```{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0897",
  "billing_entity": "Redwood, Inc (US)",
  "local_invoice_currency": "EUR",
  "amount_in_cents": 1234567,
  "display_total": "12,345.66 EUR",
  "fx_rate": "0.912345",
  "po_number": "PO-ACME-DE-4321"
}```
carla (Account Exec): Customer insists their PO must match exactly otherwise AP rejects. This is stopping their payment. We need a credited/reissued invoice in EUR that shows 12,345.67.
mike (Legal): Note VAT must still match. If we issue a difference of €0.01 we should account for VAT implications. Finance, confirm whether credit + reissue is safe for cross-entity.
ben (Finance): We can do credit note + reissue same day to the Acme GmbH entity. Need confirmation on whether we should change rounding rule or reissue a one-off manual correction.
dinesh (Billing Eng): Root cause: we bill in USD at settlement, then convert to EUR for local invoice using bank rounding to 2 decimals after converting cents -> this particular fx_rate produced 12,345.666..., we currently floor to 2 decimals in display layer for invoices which gave 12,345.66. The PO was created from our ledger rounded to nearest cent which was 12,345.67.
eva (Customer Support): Customer provided screenshot of their AP reject: "invoice total does not match PO". They're asking for a corrected PDF invoice with same invoice_id (or new corrected one?) that they can attach to PO.
carla (Account Exec): They prefer a corrected invoice (new number) referencing original INV-2026-0897 and the PO. We should avoid changing the original number.
ben (Finance): Plan: 1) Issue credit note for INV-2026-0897 for 12,345.66 EUR 2) Create new invoice INV-2026-0897-R1 for 12,345.67 EUR referencing PO 4321 and original invoice. 3) Re-attempt payment using manual charge or provide bank wire instructions. Need Engineering to confirm we can generate local-currency invoice for DE entity without triggering double-VAT.
mike (Legal): OK but finance must show VAT amounts consistent. If rounding delta affects VAT by >€0.01 it becomes problematic. Check tax breakdown.
dinesh (Billing Eng): I can add a hotfix to the invoice rendering to round to nearest cent (banker's rounding) instead of flooring. That will align display with ledger in most cases. Will push patch to staging and revert if anything flaky. ETA 4h.
ben (Finance): For this customer I'll do the manual credit/reissue once Dinesh confirms we can output the corrected PDF. Also need to update payment method: card failed with gateway error "currency_mismatch"; gateway expects card currency to match charge currency for German cards. Support, can we ask customer to provide an EUR-denominated payment method or do a wire?
eva (Customer Support): I asked the customer to either add a EUR corporate card or accept wire. They replied wire preferred. They need the corrected invoice PDF to accompany wire.
carla (Account Exec): I'll tell them estimated timelines and escalate for priority processing.
ben (Finance): Action owners: @dinesh produce corrected invoice PDF (hotfix) and confirm when ready. @ben create credit note + reissue once PDF available. @eva inform customer and collect wire remittance when they have it. @mike confirm VAT wording.
dinesh (Billing Eng): Hotfix deployed to invoice-renderer staging. Rendered new PDF for INV-2026-0897-R1 shows 12,345.67 EUR and tax lines unchanged. I will run a quick local batch to ensure no other invoices affected.
billing-bot: payment_gateway_log: pay_8321 => declined: DECLINED_CURRENCY_MISMATCH (code: 4022)
eva (Customer Support): Customer confirmed they received new PDF and will initiate wire today. "Thanks, please include bank details and show PO# on invoice".
ben (Finance): Done — created credit note CN-2026-0897 and invoice INV-2026-0897-R1, attached bank details and PO number. Sent to Acme GmbH AP.
mike (Legal): Confirmed VAT wording OK. No further legal issues for a 1 cent correction.
carla (Account Exec): Customer acknowledged and will confirm payment by EOD tomorrow.
dinesh (Billing Eng): I'll schedule the rounding change for next release; will add a regression test that compares ledger rounding vs display rounding.
eva (Customer Support): Closing loop with customer after payment. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ben (Finance): Leaving note in billing runbook to watch multi-entity FX edge-cases and PO matching.
carla (Account Exec): Filing this as a priority case for multi-entity customers.
end of thread
